# Aspose.Total MCP Server — Python via .NET

> MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for [Aspose](https://www.aspose.com/) document processing products. Connect your AI assistant to Aspose tools for working with Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, presentations, email, images, and more — all without leaving your AI client. Each Aspose product runs as its own isolated MCP server.

Hub page: https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/
Source repository: https://github.com/aspose-total/Aspose.Total-for-Python-via-.NET-MCP-Server

## Products

- [Aspose.Words MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-words-mcp-server/): Aspose.Words for Python via .NET lets developers create, modify, convert, and render Word documents without needing Microsoft Office. It supports formats such as DOCX, DOC, RTF, HTML, Markdown, PDF, and more.
- [Aspose.PDF MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-pdf-mcp-server/): Aspose.PDF for Python via .NET lets developers create, convert, and manipulate PDF files programmatically, offering features such as text extraction, document encryption, and format conversion.
- [Aspose.Cells MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-cells-mcp-server/): Aspose.Cells for Python via .NET is a spreadsheet processing library that lets you create, read, modify, and convert Excel workbooks in Python. It supports formats such as XLSX, XLS, CSV, and ODS and can export to PDF, HTML, JSON, and image formats.
- [Aspose.Slides MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-slides-mcp-server/): Aspose.Slides for Python via .NET is a library that enables Python applications to create, read, modify, merge, protect, and convert PowerPoint and OpenOffice presentations without requiring Microsoft PowerPoint.
- [Aspose.Email MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-email-mcp-server/): Aspose.Email for Python via .NET enables reading, creating, converting, and extracting data from email files such as MSG, EML, PST, MBOX and MHTML.
- [Aspose.OCR MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-ocr-mcp-server/): Aspose.OCR for Python via .NET provides OCR capabilities to extract text from images and scanned documents. It supports over 130 languages and common image formats such as JPG, PNG, TIFF, and PDF.
- [Aspose.Imaging MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-imaging-mcp-server/): Aspose.Imaging for Python via .NET is a library that provides advanced image processing capabilities such as loading, converting, resizing, cropping, applying filters, and adding watermarks without requiring external image editors. It supports many raster and vector formats and runs on both Windows and Linux platforms.
- [Aspose.BarCode MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-barcode-mcp-server/): Aspose.BarCode for Python via .NET provides APIs to generate and recognize a wide range of 1D, 2D and postal barcodes directly from Python applications.
- [Aspose.ZIP MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-zip-mcp-server/): Aspose.ZIP for Python via .NET provides tools to create, extract, list, and manage ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, and GZ archives directly from a shared files folder.
- [Aspose.HTML MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-html-mcp-server/): Aspose.HTML for Python via .NET enables conversion of HTML, MHTML and Markdown files to formats such as PDF, DOCX, PNG, JPEG, XPS and more, and provides utilities to extract text, links and manipulate HTML elements.
- [Aspose.PSD MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-psd-mcp-server/): Aspose.PSD for Python via .NET enables loading, editing, and converting Photoshop PSD and PSB files without requiring Adobe Photoshop.
- [Aspose.SVG MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-svg-mcp-server/): Aspose.SVG for Python via .NET provides server‑side tools to create, edit, query, and convert SVG files within a shared files directory.
- [Aspose.TeX MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-tex-mcp-server/): Aspose.TeX for Python via .NET provides server‑side tools for working with TeX and LaTeX files, allowing conversion to PDF, image formats, XPS and SVG as well as rendering of math formulas and figures.
- [Aspose.Page MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-page-mcp-server/): Aspose.Page for Python via .NET enables conversion, creation, and manipulation of XPS, EPS, and PS documents, offering tools to convert these formats to PDF or raster images, create new XPS files, and merge multiple XPS documents.
- [Aspose.CAD MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-cad-mcp-server/): Aspose.CAD for Python via .NET is a conversion API that lets developers render and convert CAD and BIM drawings (DWG, DXF, DWF, DGN, IFC, STL, etc.) to raster and vector formats such as PDF, PNG, JPEG, BMP, TIFF, SVG, and more, without needing any CAD software. It supports exporting whole drawings, specific layouts, or selected layers, and provides basic drawing metadata.
- [Aspose.3D MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-3d-mcp-server/): Aspose.3D for Python via .NET is a feature‑rich API that lets developers read, write, manipulate and convert 3D file formats without needing any 3D modeling software. It supports many formats such as FBX, OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA and more, providing scene creation, mesh operations and rendering capabilities.
- [Aspose.Tasks MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-tasks-mcp-server/): Aspose.Tasks for Python via .NET enables programmatic creation, conversion, and inspection of Microsoft Project files such as MPP, MPT, and MPD.
- [Aspose.Diagram MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-diagram-mcp-server/): Aspose.Diagram for Python via .NET is a Visio file manipulation library that lets you create, read, write and export Visio diagrams in formats such as VSDX, VDX, VSD, PDF and various images.
- [Aspose.Finance MCP Server](https://aspose-total.github.io/aspose-total-for-python-via-dotnet-mcp-server/aspose-finance-mcp-server/): Aspose.Finance for Python via .NET is a library that lets developers create, read, validate, and convert XBRL, iXBRL, and OFX financial documents, with support for exporting to Excel.
